about: The time axis, with text measured at `measure_per_char` px a character.

tests.name: axis: one unit for every label, and only labels that fit inside

rows.note: 1 ms over 1000 px at 1 GS/s. 50 us steps are 50 px, too close for "0.05 ms" (7 characters, 42 px, and a 16 px gap); 100 us steps are 100 px. Labels at 0 and 1 ms would hang outside.

tests.name: axis: never a step finer than one tick

rows.note: Ten 10 us ticks over 2000 px. 5 us steps would be 100 px apart, room for the widest label ("100 us", 36 px and the gap); only the one-tick floor rules them out.
